AGRICULTURE — TERMLY EXAM #1
====

GRADE: Grade 9
SUBJECT: AGRICULTURE
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Boiling point of pure water at standard pressure is about: (1 mark)
   A. 0 °C
   B. 37 °C
   C. 50 °C
   D. 100 °C

2. Why is water unsuitable for a petrol fire? (1 mark)
   A. Water can spread burning petrol instead of putting it out safely
   B. Petrol fires have no fuel
   C. Water removes heat too quickly
   D. Water always increases oxygen

3. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles.

4. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Conserving Animal Feed: Hay? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.
   D. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Conserving Animal Feed: Hay.

5. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities? (1 mark)
   A. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   B. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   C. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities.

6. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Organic Gardening? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Organic Gardening.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Organic Gardening.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Organic Gardening.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Organic Gardening.

7. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr? (1 mark)
   A. Skip labelling diagrams related to Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.
   D. Guess results without recording observations on Disinfecting Clothing and Household Articles 12 4.0 Production Techniques 4.1 Gr.

8. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   B. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   C. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.
   D. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cleaning Waste Disposal Facilities 9 3.2 Disinfecting Clothing and Household Art.

9. An element is: (1 mark)
   A. Any white crystal used in cooking
   B. A mixture of two liquids
   C. A pure substance that cannot be broken down into a simpler substance by chemical means
   D. Any substance that conducts electricity

10. Soil erosion is reduced by: (1 mark)
   A. Overgrazing continuously
   B. Burning crop residue every week
   C. Planting cover crops and terracing slopes
   D. Removing all vegetation

11. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos? (1 mark)
   A. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   C. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures 14 3.0 Hygiene Practises 3.1 Cleaning Waste Dispos.

12. Which practice best shows correct science when studying Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures? (1 mark)
   A. Guess results without recording observations on Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   B. Observe carefully, use correct terms, and follow safety rules for Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   C. Taste unknown substances to “learn faster” about Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.
   D. Skip labelling diagrams related to Cooking: Using Flour Mixtures.

13. A compound differs from a mixture because: (1 mark)
   A. Elements in a compound are chemically combined in a fixed ratio
   B. A mixture always has a fixed melting point
   C. A compound can be separated by filtering only
   D. Mixtures cannot exist in Kenya

14. Photosynthesis mainly produces: (1 mark)
   A. Nitrogen gas only
   B. Glucose and oxygen
   C. Only carbon dioxide
   D. Only water vapour

15. Which change is a physical change? (1 mark)
   A. Paper burning to ash
   B. Iron rusting
   C. Ice melting to water
   D. Milk souring

16. In a food chain, green plants are usually: (1 mark)
   A. Tertiary consumers
   B. Primary consumers only
   C. Producers
   D. Decomposers only

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
